executionOrder: Finish bounded frozen training and all3 development candidate scores. If selected=null, preserve fresh test unopened.
Freeze exactly one development-qualified checkpoint and unchanged operating point.
Pass same-pixel raw CoreML/Vision parity using unchanged production preprocessing/shared Swift NMS and existing numeric/quality policies.
Execute the new frozen physical-scene holdout once with the fixed candidate; preserve PASS or FAIL.
Only if the selected candidate passes fresh test, run one known-failure regression diagnostic on the prior37 photographs using the original74 gallery/camera App inputs and original GT.
Report complete new-test results and known-regression results together, then obtain root final release receipt before writing a usable model configuration.

knownFailureRegression.purpose: Known, previously exposed regression evidence; never a new independent/heldout accuracy estimate.
knownFailureRegression.scope: Original37 photographs, original74 actual-App gallery/camera inputs, original unchanged GT; one fixed new selected checkpoint, confidence.3/NMS.7.
requiredFullMetrics: per-image GT/predicted/TP/FP/FN/signed and absolute count error
prohibitedUses: Changing confidence or NMS thresholds from diagnostic results
Editing labels to improve the score
Calling the exposed37 an independent new test
Reporting only fresh-test success while omitting known unresolved failures
knownFailureRegression.unresolvedPolicy: Explicitly identify every known issue that remains, include the corresponding before/after counts and full metrics, and retain it in the final user-facing result. Root final release decision must see these results; no automatic success claim from fresh test alone.

implementationScope: Plan only. No change to model recipe, candidate gates, original frozen files, labels, App preprocessing, or NMS.
